about.content: Financial Mathematics & Statistics graduate from UC Santa Barbara with a keen ability to translate complex quantitative data into actionable business insights. Adept at capturing overseas market trends and bridging the gap between data mining and intuitive commercial solutions — empowering traditional enterprises to navigate digital globalization. Fluent bilingual business communicator (English/Mandarin) with deep North American cultural fluency and a sharp understanding of end-market dynamics. Highly goal-oriented with a proven track record of driving cross-functional team initiatives.

education.honors: Honors: Dean's Honors List, AP Scholar

experience.org: Disabled Students Program (DSP), UC Santa Barbara
highlights: Decomposed complex upper-division quantitative coursework (Markov Chains & Stochastic Modeling) into structured, accessible technical documentation — lowering the knowledge barrier for students requiring accessible learning support.

Operated under strict academic compliance and confidentiality protocols, ensuring zero-error cross-departmental information flow between professors and the DSP office with on-time delivery of core materials.
Optimized end-to-end information delivery pipeline, eliminating the gap between instructors and recipients, directly safeguarding target students' academic outcomes through high-quality output.

items.title: Automobile CO₂ Emission Analysis
items.description: Built a multiple linear regression model to predict vehicle carbon emissions. Applied Python data science toolkit for end-to-end analysis — from data cleaning through modeling to visualization.

items.title: Girsanov Explorer — Interactive Finance
items.description: Led a 4-person team to derive Girsanov's Theorem for risk-neutral derivative pricing (PSTAT 160B). Then independently built an interactive bilingual web explorer with live GBM simulations, real-time parameter sliders, density process visualization, and side-by-side option pricing — turning abstract stochastic calculus into an intuitive visual experience.

items.title: Credit Assessment & Pre-Loan Risk Control
items.description: Designed a pre-loan risk scoring system using real-world business transaction data to address trust deficits and default risk in B2B/B2C commerce. Led full-pipeline feature engineering and compared Logistic Regression vs. XGBoost — using Variable Importance (VIP) for business factor attribution.

items.title: B2B Trade Credit Risk Dashboard
items.description: Full-stack interactive web application that scores cross-border trade partner creditworthiness. React frontend with Python/FastAPI backend — directly operationalizing the credit risk modeling approach for real-world B2B use cases in international trade.
